The '''Yuna Crosscut''' was a tunnel carved through the cliff beneath [[Attis Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuna Crosscut appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
